interpretation_guardrail: Immediate-early stress alone is insufficient; require MuSC identity and temporal ordering
Score describes cycling and is not a lineage transition
Require repair-front spatial or directional evidence for migration claims
Transient Myod1 expression alone is insufficient
Require myogenic identity and fusion-zone or myonuclear evidence
Acute ECM expression is not automatically pathological
M2-like markers alone do not establish functional resolution
Require persistence late in time and pathology or spatial evidence
Lipid metabolism alone is insufficient; require commitment or fatty-infiltration evidence
Requires late non-recovery context and cannot be assigned from early injury severity
